column1: # Reviewed "not affected" triage for known-exploited image findings (OpenVEX
# justification values). Each entry silences only that CVE in that package,
# must expire within 31 days, and cannot override blocking-cves.tsv. Remove the
# entry as soon as the upstream image ships the fix; renew only after re-review.

column6: Brotli decoder is only linked by libcurl. Caddy (web, caddy-runtime) is a static Go binary that never loads libbrotli and its Caddyfiles enable only gzip/zstd; healthchecks use wget. The only curl call is the S3 fixture healthcheck against its own localhost, and that fixture is not deployed to hosted environments. Alpine 1.2.1-r0 exists; upstream caddy and seaweedfs images are not rebuilt yet.
Debian package in the SOPS operator image; SOPS decrypts local repository files and never decompresses Brotli network content. Upstream sops v3.13.3 has not been rebuilt with 1.0.9-2+deb12u1.
